items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 5:53:1
items.html: Bina is called Yod-Vav-Dalet in the aspect of the three lights in her, and their order is Yod-Dalet-Vav: The male is called Yod after Hochma, being his offspring, as above. And the female, who is Bina, together with the light of Hesed in her, is the secret of the Hey: the light of Hesed is discerned as the Vav that is inside the Hey, and Bina is discerned as the Dalet that encompasses the Vav, this being because she is the aspect of the GAR of this Vav.
